hypotheses.mechanism: One candidate only: ridge on intercept, 24h log-return momentum, 24h realized hourly log-return volatility, and their one product interaction. No post-hoc regime threshold, feature search, or multi-horizon selection; volatility may predict scale rather than sign, so directional alpha is not presumed.
hypotheses.pre_origin_features: Require 25 consecutive hourly close values each independently first-observed before actual forecast publication. Set m=log(P_t/P_t-24), v=population_sd(log(P_j/P_j-1), j=t-23..t), interaction=m*v. These are feature definitions only, not as-of source attestations; exact model fit/feature scaling must be frozen before any permitted prospective fit.
hypotheses.falsification_rule: Do not promote unless one separately authorized and preregistered full-elapsed horizon and all scheduled origins show dependence-adjusted positive paired improvement over persistence on primary absolute log-price error with independently verified issuance and sources; expose abstentions and placebo comparison. Reject or revise if interaction adds nothing beyond the non-interaction ablation.
hypotheses.negative_control: Prespecified single ablation with the SAME training schedule and ridge settings but interaction term set to zero; retain intercept, momentum, and volatility. Any interaction-specific edge must beat this ablation in a separately preregistered superiority comparison; avoid selecting whichever ablation wins ex post.
